findings.location: source.html paragraph: near execution speech ("Vollmar... Hans ... said: 'I do not know what more I should say ... that they might be saved; this I would wish for everyone.'")
findings.source_quote: “I do not know what more I should say than that I wish everyone would come to a knowledge of their sins and repent, that they might be saved; this I would wish for everyone.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the clause to convey that Hans wished people to be saved (gered), not lost. Replace the translated sentence inside the same paragraph and HTML structure with an accurate Afrikaans rendering. Suggested replacement in Afrikaans (preserve quotes and punctuation): “Ek weet nie wat meer ek sou sê as dat ek wens dat almal tot die kennis van hul sondes sal kom en sal bekeer, sodat hulle gered mag word; dit wens ek vir almal.”
findings.translation_quote: “Ek weet nie wat meer ek sou sê as dat ek wens dat almal die kennis van hul sondes sal kom en bekeer sal word, sodat hulle verlore sal word; dit sal ek vir almal wens.”
